## Description

Constructs persistence landscapes from 1-dimensional Betti homological loops in rolling correlation point clouds, trading relative value mispricings when landscape norms deviate from equilibrium bounds.

## Where it may fit

Statistical arbitrage across multi-asset classes, cyclical asset co-movement regime shifts.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Desks, Quantitative Multi-Asset Funds.

## Required data

Multivariate rolling distance matrices, asset return series, liquidity filters.

## Caveats

Persistence landscape vector norm calculations require efficient vectorization for real-time execution.
